name: m9m Design System — The Control Room

narrative.craftFocus: Sharper type hierarchy — n8n's layout skeleton is the contract; typography, token discipline, and tonal depth are where m9m goes further
narrative.audience: Platform and operations engineers who already know n8n
narrative.voice: Technical, plain-spoken, never chatty. Short sentences. No exclamation marks. No emoji in product copy.
narrative.referenceAuthority: n8n/packages/frontend/@n8n/design-system/src/css — values adopted verbatim; gaps filled under DESIGN.md rules
parityContract: node 96x96, radius 16px, border 1.5px, no rest shadow
node creator 385px right overlay with 0.7 scrim
NDV full-screen modal, 3 resizable columns, settings min 260px
no execution log strip inside the editor

brand.name: Signal Pink
brand.role: Actionable intent only — primary buttons, active nav, focus

accent.name: Ember Orange
accent.role: Inline emphasis — links, slider fills, checked controls

neutral.name: Graphite Neutral
neutral.role: Surfaces, borders, text — cool near-achromatic ramp, hue 89.88

mono.family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

body.use: Default UI text, buttons, list rows

rules: 100-200ms for pointer-triggered changes, 400ms max for panel transitions
opacity and transform only — never width, height, top, left
no entrance animation on load, no decorative looping motion

components.name: Button / Primary
Button / Secondary
Button / Ghost Icon
Input / Text field
Tag chip
Canvas node card
Node creator row
Canvas toolbar pill
Status badge
AI assistant header

forbidden: any brand color other than Signal Pink on primary surfaces
shadow + border + ring on the same element
animating width, height, top, or left
arbitrary Tailwind spacing values outside the 13-step scale
dead CSS variables or unused color scales
required: focus-visible ring on every interactive element
dark theme via the same semantic tokens
